decisions.reason: The necessary É-accent impact is already captured by its same-message MODIFY, which makes the accent the literal Hero V terminal and removes the obsolete accent_form attribute.
The preferred Option 2 Hero V was already the current geometry reference; the source reports that the presentation departed from it but does not require another value change to the Hero V state.
The same-message MODIFY already records the governing rule that the Hero V, second V, and É accent share one completely unified terminal gesture.
The source changes geometric terminal relationships, not the deferred champagne-gold treatment, material qualities, or material-design sequence.
The decision concerns the three-form V system and does not resume or alter the deferred construction of the remaining proprietary wordmark letterforms.
The unified terminal supports the existing proprietary identity goal but does not change any current brand-expression rule or attribute.
The source does not change or resume the deferred complete-wordmark composition, kerning, rhythm, or hierarchy requirements.
Refining the shared terminal gesture does not alter the established wordmark-only identity or the rule that no separate icon or monogram is required.
